pc.help.subtitle: Questions and answers, and where to get help
pc.help.add.q: How do I add a contact on a computer?
pc.help.add.a: Open New chat. Paste the person's OSHI code or invite link, choose a picture of their QR code, or scan their code with this computer's camera. Your own QR code is on the same screen for them to scan.
pc.help.same_account.q: Is OSHI on my computer the same account as on my phone?
pc.help.same_account.a: Only if you choose it. On the first screen, import your phone's recovery key and this computer becomes the same identity. Create a new identity instead and the computer is a separate account with its own address.
pc.help.offline.q: Does OSHI work without internet on a computer?
pc.help.offline.a: On a local network, yes: OSHI computers and phones on the same Wi-Fi find each other and exchange messages directly. A computer has no Bluetooth mesh. With a LoRa radio connected, short texts can also travel by radio.
pc.help.groups.q: How do I join a group?
pc.help.groups.a: Paste the group's invite link in New chat, or choose a picture of its QR code. Public groups announced by OSHI devices on your network appear in Discover groups.
pc.help.passcode.q: I forgot my passcode. What now?
pc.help.passcode.a: On the lock screen choose "Forgot your passcode?" and paste your recovery key. OSHI opens and removes the passcode; you can set a new one in Settings › Security. Wrong passcodes never delete anything.
